name: application-timezone-overlap-bar
title: Timezone Overlap Bar
description: A 24-hour visual track comparing working hours across two or more timezones, highlighting the shared window when everyone is available.
useWhen: Scheduling a meeting or call across two or more timezones and needing to see the shared working-hours window at a glance.
A distributed team page or scheduling tool needs to show relative availability rather than let users mentally convert times.
avoidWhen: The user only needs to pick a single timezone value, not compare working hours across zones — use the timezone-picker component instead.
Precise minute-level scheduling is required — this is a glanceable overview, not a booking calendar.
responsiveBehavior: Each timezone row is a fixed-height track with a proportionally positioned highlight; the label column has a fixed width so multiple rows stay aligned, and the whole bar shrinks with its container down to narrow viewports.
accessibility: Each timezone's working-hours range is echoed as plain text (e.g. '9am–5pm') alongside the visual bar, not conveyed by position alone.
The overlap window is stated in text ('4h overlap', '1 hour when all three teams overlap') independent of the highlighted bar segment.
A text legend maps each color to its meaning (working hours vs. overlap) for users who cannot distinguish the color difference visually.
